dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: The unparalleled Beetle-battling competition "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl" is upon us!

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: All are welcome to watch this exciting Beetle showdown on the island to the northwest of Araumi.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Come and witness the crowning moment of Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King wiping the floor with Grandmaster Hanakado!
